scientific_integrity: The unweighted square graph decomposition is credited to Higashitani and Mori. The extension to arbitrary positive weights and the summand-cone classification are the claimed contributions. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Positive weights on a four-cycle only; no claims for general weighted graphs or publication-priority certification. Finite exact checks supplement analytic proof.
title: Weighted four-cycle symmetric edge polytopes: exact Minkowski-decomposition strata
